provider: CUHK Divinity School of Chung Chi College 2025-26 Student Handbook and current BA Theology curriculum
academicYear: 2025-26; BA requirements applicable to students admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter
note: The official 2025-26 Student Handbook publishes the current Bachelor of Arts in Theology curriculum for students admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter: 9 units of Faculty Package, 28 units of Major Required Courses and 33 units of Major Electives within a 123-unit degree. This supplement exposes the 44 unique courses explicitly listed in the Handbook's Major Required and Theological Studies Areas 1-5 tables: ten Major Required courses and 34 additional Area courses. It omits the cross-department Faculty Package and the open CURE elective pool because their complete current titles and applicability are not closed by the BA course tables. The Handbook leaves the THEO2224 unit cell blank; the official current course list and THEO2224 course page both confirm 3 units. The Handbook writes THEO2234 as 'Catholic Dogmatic', while the official current course list and course page use 'Catholic Dogmatics'; this supplement uses the current course-page title. Ten Special Topics courses marked with a caret may be taken more than once in different terms, which the local course-key model does not automatically audit. The resulting list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 70-unit Major or 123-unit graduation audit.
